brand_descriptor: IT & AI solutions and corporate advisory.
hero_body: Expected methods produce nothing but expected results. Whatever sits inside the industry average, the domestic consensus, or the well-precedented option has already been claimed by someone else. From Singapore, we work across borders and sectors to reach the answers that lie outside the average.
about_body_1: CAUCHYE is named after the Cauchy distribution. Named in turn for the 19th-century mathematician Augustin-Louis Cauchy, it has no expected value: however many samples you draw, the sample mean never converges, and the law of large numbers does not hold. It describes a world where the average is simply not a usable instrument.
about_body_2: That is our starting point. Anything an average can settle has been settled already. What we take on sits outside it — AI implementations with little precedent, platforms that do not yet exist, and cross-border assets that no domestic benchmark describes. Results there cannot be predicted from the mean, which is precisely why they can exceed it.
business_ai_body: From AI strategy and systems engineering to AI-native organization design, training, and enablement. We support production adoption from both the technology and operating-model sides.
business_advisory_lead: Turn the market's view into decisions that build value.
business_advisory_body: We connect capital-markets perception with management decisions through IR and shareholder relations, investor perception studies, capital allocation, portfolio review, and M&A evaluation.
ai_meta_description: AI strategy, systems integration, AI-native organization design, training, and enablement delivered as one connected programme.
ai_hero_title_accent: Put it to work across operations and teams.
ai_hero_body: From AI strategy and workflow design to systems engineering, security, training, and enablement. We build systems people keep using and teams that can keep improving them.
ai_models_label: Work across leading AI models and platforms
ai_models_note: We select models for the requirement and avoid unnecessary vendor lock-in. Marks shown indicate compatibility, not partnership or certification.
ai_partners_title: Specialists and organizations we work alongside.
ai_challenge_1: You want to use AI but cannot identify the right first workflow
ai_challenge_2: A proof of concept works, but production and legacy integration remain blocked
ai_challenge_3: ChatGPT or Claude is available, but adoption varies widely by team
ai_challenge_4: Security and data-governance concerns prevent broader rollout
ai_challenge_5: You want capability to remain in-house instead of outsourcing it indefinitely
ai_services_title: One team from strategy to systems to adoption.
ai_service_1_body: We map workflows and evaluate opportunity, feasibility, and risk, then turn priorities into an executable roadmap.
ai_service_2_body: We design and build agents, data foundations, workflows, and internal tools, integrating them safely with systems already in place.
ai_service_3_body: We reshape workflows, engineering practices, guidance, and evaluation so teams can keep using and improving AI responsibly.
ai_service_4_body: Practical programmes tailored to executives, business teams, and engineers, using real operating problems rather than generic exercises.
ai_clients_title: Examples of the organizations we support
ai_client_pe_body: We help private equity portfolio companies use AI to transform operations and improve profitability. From workflow discovery and priority setting through implementation and adoption, the work is designed to build enterprise value.
ai_client_company_body: Starting from frontline work and existing systems, we combine AI implementation, security design, and training so adoption can continue across the organization.
ai_security_title: Security is a foundation, not an afterthought.
ai_security_body: A security specialist with real incident-response experience participates from the design stage. That lets AI involving confidential data move beyond a proof of concept toward an architecture suitable for broader deployment.
ai_security_point_2: Assessment of AI-specific attacks and data-exposure risks
ai_security_point_3: Access control, auditability, and operating guidance
ai_why_title: Working systems and internal capability remain after delivery.
ai_why_point_1: Measure success through time saved and better decisions, not AI adoption itself
ai_why_point_2: Move beyond a proof of concept to production connected with existing systems
ai_why_point_3: Choose the right AI for each use case without forced model lock-in
ai_why_point_4: Design for security, operations, and broader deployment from the beginning
ai_why_point_5: Keep improving in-house through documentation, reviews, and training
d6e_foundation_title: Turn accumulated experience into a shared foundation.
d6e_foundation_body: CAUCHYE ASIA develops d6e, our own AI workflow foundation. Where the engagement calls for it, d6e accelerates integrations, access control, and operating design. We do not make d6e a prerequisite: the right architecture follows the security requirements, existing environment, operating model, and future options.
d6e_foundation_point_1: Architectures deployable in the customer's environment
d6e_foundation_point_2: Existing-system integration through APIs and MCP
gateway_title: Cut AI costs. Automate customer billing. Get paid sooner.
gateway_body: d6e AI Gateway selects lower-cost execution paths request by request while preserving the required speed. It connects customer-level usage to invoice creation and payment tracking, with optional early funding for selected receivables.
gateway_point_1: Reduce eligible AI processing costs by up to 50%
gateway_point_2: Create customer invoices from usage and track payment
gateway_point_3: Fund selected issued invoices before they are due
ai_faq_title: Questions we often hear before an engagement
ai_faq_1_q: Can we talk before there is a defined development project?
ai_faq_1_a: Yes. We can begin with workflow mapping and an AI opportunity assessment, clarifying the objective, available data, constraints, and the smallest useful validation.
ai_faq_2_q: Can you work with tools we already use, such as ChatGPT or Claude?
ai_faq_2_a: Yes. We design around existing contracts and cloud environments where appropriate. No specific model or CAUCHYE platform is mandatory.
ai_faq_3_q: Can you support adoption inside the organization as well as development?
ai_faq_3_a: Yes. We can design usage guidance, role-specific training, workshops based on real work, and the review practices needed for sustained adoption.
ai_cta_body: The problem does not need to be fully defined. Tell us how work happens today and what you want to change.
advisory_meta_description: Support for IR and shareholder relations, investor perception studies, capital allocation, business portfolios, and M&A evaluation.
advisory_hero_title_accent: into decisions that build enterprise value.
advisory_hero_body: From understanding how Asian institutional investors see the company to capital allocation, portfolio choices, and M&A evaluation, we connect capital-markets dialogue with management decisions.
advisory_services_title: Understand the market's view and make the next options concrete.
advisory_service_1_body: We conduct anonymous research with current holders, former holders, and investors who have never held, then identify awareness, business understanding, and barriers to investment and recommend the next disclosure and dialogue priorities.
advisory_service_2_body: We consider growth, liquidity, risk, and shareholder returns together and organize the options for building enterprise value over the medium to long term.
advisory_service_3_body: We clarify strategic intent, target areas, expected effects, and principal risks to support evaluation and management decisions.
advisory_strength_title: Connecting Japanese companies with Asian investors from Singapore.
advisory_strength_body: We read the company's disclosure closely and design the research around its specific questions. We interview Japanese-language decision makers in Japanese and others in English, quantifying assessments an issuer may struggle to obtain directly.
advisory_strength_point_2: Individual research with current, former, and non-holders
advisory_strength_point_3: Quantified awareness, understanding, and non-ownership reasons
advisory_strength_point_4: Recommendations for the next disclosure and dialogue themes
advisory_cta_title: Clarify the next question around enterprise value.
advisory_cta_body: Tell us what you need to understand about investor perception, IR, shareholder relations, or capital allocation.
leader_bio: Graduated in Economics from Kyoto University and completed an MBA at its Graduate School of Management; currently enrolled in the doctoral programme at its Graduate School of Informatics. As a white-hat engineer, recovered crypto assets worth roughly ¥500 million from an active hack. Also serves as Co-General Partner of a construction-materials leasing fund in Singapore, through a subsidiary joint venture.
